effect: The archive now names, in one line of its report on the pull request, every file it commits from the change's folder that git never tracked, so a stray file is never pushed without the user seeing it.
detail: src/core/pr/tail.ts gains observations.carried_untracked (untracked paths under the archived directory); PR_ARCHIVE_TAIL_REFERENCE names it in the same note as unrelated_staged / unrelated_unstaged; a behaviour test in test/core/pr/tail.test.ts declares the scenario.
